Summary: Live signal pool: repeat ids are dropped by the router and the 5-minute window is shorter than the slowest feed's polling interval, so the MAP empties
Description: 1) Original intent: the live field (and the MAP formation built from it) stays populated while feeds are healthy. 2) Acceptance criteria: a feed that re-dispatches an observation with the same id keeps its pool entry current (count unchanged, timestamp refreshed); the window used for the live field is not shorter than the slowest feed's polling interval, so entries do not age out between polls; the MAP and the Analysis field do not empty on a healthy session. 3) Current implementation state: (a) surfaceRouter._resolveOp (src/engine/surfacerouter.js) returns null for a known id with no changed tracked field, and the pool subscriber '__gravity__' has no tracked fields, so a repeated dispatch (for example fred-<series>-<date> from usefredsignals.js) never refreshed its pool entry. Fixed on Dev in cc51975 (router passes everything to '__gravity__'; domaingravity.js upserts by id). Not on Prod. (b) DEFAULT_WINDOW_MS is 300000 (5 min, domaingravity.js line 17); FRED polls every 5 min and EDGAR every 15 min with a new id each poll (useedgarsignals.js), so EDGAR-sourced entries are present for 5 of every 15 minutes. NOT fixed: proposed a longer window for the map's own field only (30 minutes = 2x the 15-minute EDGAR poll, the same 2x ratio the pool already prunes at); the Founder has not chosen a value. Prod screenshot 2026-10-06 showed 0 of 6 domains and an empty MAP with 'no domain signal recorded'. 4) Dependencies: domaingravity.js, surfacerouter.js, structurepanel.jsx (buildPerceptionField call, no windowMs), perceptionread.js; Founder decision on the window value; release gate (Deploy to Prod ticket) for any Prod change. 5) Superseded by a newer ticket: none; follows KRYL-1364 (snapshot refresh, Done, on Prod). 6) Maps to current product model: yes (live field, section 12 signal ingestion). Verification: read from code plus a headless check that a repeated id keeps count 1 and refreshes ts; not runtime-traced on Prod.
